aboutGame.title: What is Sort The Capybaras?
paragraphs: Sort The Capybaras is a cozy sorting puzzle game built around a simple rule: you can only pick up the capybara sitting on top of a stack, and it can only land on a matching capybara or an empty pen. Each board asks you to group every capybara by its color, pattern, or accessory before your free slots run out.

What starts as a gentle warm-up quickly becomes a planning test. Boards add buried capybaras, locked slots, move limits, and tighter pens, so the players who scan the whole board before tapping are the ones who clear levels in a single pass. Our wiki collects the sorting mechanics, level breakdowns, store priorities, and control tips that keep your herd tidy.

faq.title: Sort The Capybaras FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Sort The Capybaras.

items.question: What is Sort The Capybaras?
items.answer: Sort The Capybaras is a cozy sorting puzzle game. Capybaras arrive in stacked pens with different colors, patterns, and accessories, and you move them into matching groups until every pen holds a single type.

items.question: How do you play Sort The Capybaras?
items.answer: You can only pick up the capybara sitting on top of a stack, and it can only land on a matching capybara or an empty pen. Clear every container by grouping identical capybaras together and the board is solved.

items.question: What should I buy first in the Sort The Capybaras store?
items.answer: Extra holding slots come first because they are permanent and make every future board more forgiving. Undo, shuffle, and extra-move power-ups are worth saving for levels that have beaten you several times.

items.question: Does Sort The Capybaras have multiplayer?
items.answer: Sort The Capybaras is built as a single-player puzzle experience. The community side lives on Discord and Reddit, where players compare sorting routes and share board screenshots.

items.question: Which platforms can I play Sort The Capybaras on?
items.answer: Sort The Capybaras has a Steam page, and cozy sorting games in this genre usually launch on mobile and desktop. Check the official store listing for the exact platforms in your region.

items.question: Is Sort The Capybaras hard for a beginner?
items.answer: No. The opening levels work as tutorials, and the core rule takes about a minute to learn. The challenge builds later, when empty pens get scarce and buried capybaras force you to plan several moves ahead.
